> .Authenticating                                       property  s         "/xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/chassis/BMC_0"        emits-change

So you would hardcode a D-Bus inventory path here, and then some other code would create an association? If so, hardcoded D-Bus object paths aren't the right level of abstraction for these config files.

An alternative would be the new proposed topology associations https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/entity-manager/+/82817.  When that goes in, you could have EM create associations between of its objects for you, without hardcoding object paths.

Yes, D-Bus inventory path will be hardcoded in this. Can you please share how we can add 2 associations?. You meant topololgy schema needs exetension for PortType ?.
Also in the schema type for `ConnectsToName` is name, for Authenticating and Reporting property name will be different.
https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/entity-manager/+/82817 has an updated schema/docs for topology associations.

As per SPDM upstream design the associations for Reporting and Authenticating will be created by the SPDM daemon itself. We don't need to create association in EM itself.

https://github.com/openbmc/docs/blob/master/designs/redfish-spdm-attestation.md

Here is the snippet of EM config which we need to update Authenticating and Reporting association in Component Integrity and TrustedComponent D-Bus objects hosted by SPDM. Can you please help how can we solve this issue with #82817

```
{
    "Exposes": [
        {
            "EID": 14,
            "TrustedComponentType": "discrete",
            "Name": "RoT_BMC_0",
            "Type": "MCTPTcpRequester",
            "Authenticating": "/xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/chassis/BMC_0",
            "Reporting": "/xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/chassis/RoT_BMC_0"
        }
    ],
    "Name": "RoT_BMC_0",
    "Probe": "xyz.openbmc_project.MCTP.Endpoint({'EID': 14})",
    "Type": "Chassis"
}
```

You define a Port on your 2 entities with matching names, and entity-manager will then create the associations between them if they are both probed.  The examples in https://github.com/openbmc/entity-manager/blob/master/docs/associations.md have more details.  It will take some minor EM code changes to support the new association names.
